article.title: ‘They face an existential threat’: Eli Clifton on the past, present, and future of the Israel Lobby
article.author: Michael Arria
article.content: Eli Clifton speaks to Mondoweiss about the upcoming U.S. midterm elections, the shifting landscape of AIPAC, and his new book, Israel's Lobby: America in the Grip of a Foreign Power.
